question: A robot-vacuum test bench fires a 49000 gram sled along a rail 3.2 m long. The sled's speed in m/s is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 14x + 48 = 0. The bench logs the sled's energy of motion in kJ, multiplies it by 12 for the 12 sleds in a batch, and subtracts 16 kJ consumed by the bench's own drive motor to give the batch balance (negative meaning a net loss). Four batches are run. What is the total balance over the 4 batches, in kJ?

The figure a lift engineer must enter, in kN, is the total cable load: the pull needed to accelerate the car plus 16 N of guide-rail friction. The car has a mass of 109 kg. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 19 more than the largest whole number that divides both 71 and 26 exactly. What total cable load, in kN, does the engineer enter?

A test buggy's position along a straight desert track, in metres, is s(t) = 4t^3 - 6t^2 with t in seconds. An engineer takes the buggy's acceleration at t = 3 s and uses that number as the speed, in m/s, of a 14 kg projectile fired from a launcher on the same range. The projectile's energy of motion at that speed is recorded in kJ. The launcher fires 10 identical projectiles per salvo, and the range fires 5 salvos. What total energy, in kJ, is recorded for the 5 salvos?

A car-wash conveyor pushes a 120 kg dolly along a track 22 m long. The dolly's acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 24 = 0. The conveyor drives 12 such dollies at once, each with the force that produces that acceleration; a tension spring relieves 4 N of the combined push, and a brush drag adds 3 N to it. Two identical conveyors run side by side. What total push, in N, do the 2 conveyors deliver?

A rocket-sled crew has 8 identical booster cartridges and counts every way of choosing 4 of them for one run; that count is used as the sled's acceleration in m/s^2. The sled has a mass of 138000 grams and its run lasts 4.5 s. The thrust needed for that acceleration, plus 20 N of rail friction, is the load on one rail clamp. There are 7 identical clamps sharing identical loads, and a counterweight relieves 29 N from their combined total. What is the combined clamp load, in kN?

A projectile of mass 24 kg is fired from a test mortar with a barrel 1.8 m long. Its muzzle speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 8x between x = 2 and x = 4. The muzzle energy of motion is adjusted by subtracting 6 J lost to barrel friction and adding 20 J from the sabot spring, and the adjusted energy is recorded in kJ. There are 9 identical shots fired. What total adjusted energy, in kJ, is recorded for the 9 shots?

A pneumatic sorting machine flicks parcels of mass 98000 grams along a chute. Each parcel's acceleration in m/s^2 equals the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 11. The machine flicks 12 parcels at once, each with the force that produces that acceleration. On top of the combined flicking force the machine's frame also carries 19 N from a return spring, then 29 N from the chute's guide rollers, and then 14 N from a sensor bracket. What total force, in N, does the frame carry?

A cargo sled of mass 59 kg is pulled across ice on a course 400 m long. Its speed in m/s is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 13x + 42 = 0. The sled's energy of motion at that speed, less 14 J lost to runner friction, is written into the log in kJ. The logger then adds 20 kJ for the energy in the sled's fuel cell and subtracts 15 kJ reserved for the return leg. What figure, in kJ, ends up in the log?

A 3000 gram drone is calibrated on a test range. Its flight speed in m/s is 6 more than the area under the curve y = 5x^2 + 8x between x = 0 and x = 2. Four identical drones fly at that speed in a group. What is the total energy of motion of the 4 drones, in kJ?

The figure a range officer needs, in kJ, is the net energy of a volley: the gross energy of the volley expressed in kJ, minus 12 kJ absorbed by the backstop, minus a further 1 kJ dissipated in the sabots. The volley consists of 6 identical projectiles, each of mass 7 kg and length 0.4 m, every one carrying the same energy of motion. The projectiles' speed in m/s equals the number of ways of choosing 2 firing lanes out of 11. What net energy, in kJ, does the officer record?

The number a quarry engineer must report, in kN, taking the direction of travel as positive, is the resultant on a skip: the drive load, minus 24 kN of brake force acting against travel, minus a further 18 kN of cable drag acting against travel. The drive load, expressed in kN, is the force producing the skip's acceleration plus 1 N of bearing friction. The skip has a mass of 65000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 4x^2 + 4x between x = 2 and x = 3. What resultant, in kN, does the engineer report?

The figure a workshop supervisor wants, in kJ (negative meaning a net loss), is 3 times the per-shift energy balance of a test bench. The per-shift balance is the combined energy of motion of 4 identical trolleys, expressed in kJ, minus 16 kJ consumed by the bench's hydraulic pump. Each trolley has a mass of 12 kg and a wheelbase of 0.8 m. The trolleys' speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 247 and 317 exactly. What figure, in kJ, does the supervisor record?

A vehicle-crash lab fires sleds of mass 172000 grams along a rail 45 m long. Each sled's acceleration in m/s^2 is 27 less than the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 8x between x = 1 and x = 4. Each sled is pushed by the force that produces that acceleration. A rack holds 3 sleds, a bay holds 12 identical racks, and the lab has 10 identical bays, all firing at once. What total push, in N, do all the sleds receive together?

A robot lawnmower's position along a straight lane, in metres, is s(t) = 5t^3 + 5t^2 with t in seconds. Its speed at t = 1 s, reduced by 7, is used as the launch speed in m/s of a 32000 gram test sled on a track 9 m long. The sled's energy of motion at launch is measured; a batch is 8 identical sleds, and a latch spring adds 6 J to the batch total. What is the batch total, in J?

The figure a test-track manager wants, in kJ (negative meaning a net loss), is the session balance: the gross session energy expressed in kJ, minus 26 kJ consumed by the track's launch motor. The gross session energy is 3 identical runs, each run being the energy of motion of a 27 kg sled plus 15 J released by its brake spring. The sled's speed in m/s is set equal to the acceleration at t = 2 s of a pace car whose position in metres is s(t) = 1t^3 + 4t^2 with t in seconds. What session balance, in kJ, does the manager record?

A lab bench drives a slider of mass 17000 grams along a rail. The slider's acceleration in m/s^2 is the largest whole number that divides both 268 and 99 exactly. The force producing that acceleration is expressed in kN, and 6 identical sliders share the bench under identical drive. To the combined drive force the bench frame adds 23 kN of clamping load, and a counterbalance then relieves 15 kN. What net load, in kN, does the bench frame carry?

The number a fairground engineer needs, in kN, is the total drive load of 2 identical carousels, each carousel driving 12 identical cars. The load per car, expressed in kN, is the force producing its acceleration plus 28 N of bearing friction. Each car has a mass of 38000 grams and a seat height of 0.6 m. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0. What total drive load, in kN, does the engineer report?

A courier hub has 11 dispatch lanes, and the number of ways of choosing 2 of them, reduced by 7, is used as the speed in m/s of its delivery drones. Each drone has a mass of 40 kg and a rotor span of 1.3 m. A drone's energy of motion at that speed is recorded in kJ. A flight of 10 identical drones has the combined figure, to which the hub adds 15 kJ held in its launch capacitor bank. What total, in kJ, does the hub record?

A rocket sled of mass 189000 grams is tested on a desert rail. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is found by taking the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 8 = 0, multiplying by 11, and subtracting 26. The rail clamp must carry the force producing that acceleration, plus 12 N of rail friction, plus 26 N from an instrumentation tether. What total load, in N, does the rail clamp carry?

The value an elevator technician wants, in kN, is the net cable load: the combined pull on 10 identical counterweights minus 14 N of relief from a balance spring. Each counterweight has a mass of 55 kg, and each is pulled with the force producing its acceleration. That acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 14 = 0. What net cable load, in kN, does the technician record?

The figure a bowling-alley engineer wants, in kJ, is the energy budget of a lane: 18 kJ of stored ball-return energy plus the combined energy of motion of 12 identical heavy test balls, expressed in kJ. Each ball has a mass of 36 kg. Each ball's speed in m/s is 2 times the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0. What energy budget, in kJ, does the engineer record?

The number a factory wants, in N, is the total motor load for 7 identical lines, each line driving 12 identical carts, each cart's motor carrying the same load. The load per motor is the force producing the cart's acceleration, less 11 N supplied by a helper spring, plus 5 N of belt friction. Each cart has a mass of 89000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 5x^2 + 0x between x = 0 and x = 1. What total motor load, in N, does the factory report?

The figure a marina wants, in kN, is the total load on a boat-lift frame: 16 kN of standing load plus the combined pull of 2 identical lifts, each lift carrying 9 identical cradles. The pull on each cradle, expressed in kN, is the force producing its acceleration. Each cradle has a mass of 49 kg. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0. What total load, in kN, does the marina report?

The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is a final tally: an intermediate figure plus 27 kJ from a heater bank plus 1 kJ from a backup cell. The intermediate figure, expressed in kJ, is the energy of motion of a 16 kg trolley minus 26 J lost to friction. The trolley rides a bench 3 m long. Its speed in m/s is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0. What final tally, in kJ, does the lab record?

A robotic pallet shuttle of mass 77 kg runs on a warehouse rail. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is set by the controller as follows: take the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 3x between x = 0 and x = 2, multiply by 11, then subtract 25, subtract 10 more, and finally subtract 18. The rail is level and frictionless. What force, in N, must the drive supply to produce that acceleration?
